tagline: Product feeds for Google Shopping, Meta, Pinterest, Microsoft/Bing Shopping and other channels, as XML, JSON, CSV or TXT, generated on a schedule and checked before they go live.
key_features: Ready templates for Google, Meta, Pinterest and Microsoft/Bing
XML, JSON, CSV and delimited TXT
Template editor with syntax highlighting, and column mapper
Scheduled generation in batches, with a log
Optional SFTP, FTP or FTPS upload

benefits.title: One catalogue, every channel
benefits.text: Start from a ready template for Google Shopping, Meta, Pinterest or Microsoft, or build your own feed for a price comparison site or an ERP.

benefits.title: No broken files online
benefits.text: Every item and the finished file are checked. An invalid file is never published, and the previous one stays in place.

benefits.title: Fresh feeds without effort
benefits.text: Feeds are rebuilt at the times you choose, in batches, so even large catalogues are generated without blocking the store.

showcase.label: Feeds
showcase.title: All feeds at a glance
showcase.text: File link, schedule, next run, last result, items and size for every feed. Generate, duplicate, enable or disable feeds from the grid.

showcase.label: XML and JSON
showcase.title: A template language made for feeds
showcase.text: Print any product value with filters such as strip_tags, truncate or price. The editor highlights template tags, filters, strings and the XML or JSON around them, with line numbers. Output is escaped automatically and the language has no access to PHP.

showcase.label: CSV and TXT
showcase.title: Columns in a simple mapper
showcase.text: Header, value and default per column, drag to reorder, with delimiter, enclosure, encoding, line ending and header row options.

showcase.label: Preview
showcase.title: Check before you save
showcase.text: One click on Preview renders the feed for the first matching products from the values in the form, including unsaved changes, highlighted with line numbers and validated. Template errors name the line. Nothing is written.

showcase.label: Filters
showcase.title: Only the products the channel needs
showcase.text: Status, stock, product types, attribute sets, visibility, categories, attribute conditions and excluded SKUs. Configurable products as parents, variants or both.

showcase.label: Google categories
showcase.title: Map your categories to Google's taxonomy
showcase.text: Search Google's product categories by name. Subcategories inherit the nearest mapped parent, so a few mappings cover the whole tree.
